decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed conversion of an existing garage to form a habitable room in the existing dwellinghouse and the conversion of the outbuilding to form a playroom/garage will not be detrimental the existing dwellinghouse or have any associated negative impacts on the adjoining dwellings or surrounding area. The proposal has been designed in accordance with the provisions of Policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and Policy T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, Section 11.4 of the Unitary Development Plan - Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997) and Section 7 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 24904 B'A' shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 6 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 7 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [    ].
description: Conversion of existing garage to form habitable room in existing dwellinghouse and conversion with alterations and additions of outbuilding to form playroom/garage and new vehicular access onto Stucley Road.
